opening_message:
Ticket 1: Alyssa Rose (employee ID E026) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E026.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: E026 (Alyssa Rose) is a full-time Analyst requesting write access to Payroll. Full-time employees may have up to write; admin requires owning the role (Payroll Specialist), which does not apply. Requested write is within policy, so recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E026 (Alyssa Rose) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training (never admin). Requested write exceeds the maximum, so recommend granting read.
reason: HR's record (authoritative for employment status) shows E026 (Alyssa Rose) is a full-time Analyst. Full-time employees may be granted up to write; admin would require owning the system (Payroll Specialist), which does not apply. The requested level (write) is within the maximum, so grant write.

- Security agent: employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read.

Policy: full_time employees: up to write (admin only if role owns system - Analyst doesn't own Payroll). So full-time Analyst requesting write → write is within policy.

Contractor: read, or write only with advanced security training. Security says contractor with basic training → max is read.

The Security agent looked up employment type in their database before writing. HR also looked up. Hmm, who to trust? The team memory contains both. As the Approver, I need to make a decision.

The discrepancy is material. Let me think about which source is more authoritative for employment type. Typically HR is the source of truth for employment type. But the Security agent also looked it up. The task may be testing how we handle conflicting info.
